newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brasmotor cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brasmotor cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said in a report it was downgrading its long-term rating on Brazilian home appliances manufacturer Brasmotor to neutral from buy.
-- "The major reason for this opinion change is the lack of long-term earnings growth and visibility," it said.
-- Brasmotor earnings next year are expected to drop due to increasing competition, the brokerage said.
-- Merrill Lynch forecasts earnings of 50.55 reais per 1,000 shares for Brasmotor in 1997 and 46.15 reais for 1998. Last year, Brasmotor had earnings of 48.13 reais per 1,000 shares, it added.
-- "The negative reaction of the share price already reflects, in our opinion, most of the downside relative to possible consumer restrictions to be implemented by the government," it said.
-- Brasmotor preferred shares were trading at 245 reais, down 0.81 percent, on the Sao Paulo bourse.
